title: Country Estate Refinance Case Study - Silver Oak Capital
summary: Case study of a refinance of a large English countryside estate. A Monaco-based introducer approached Silver Oak Capital for help refinancing a borrower's costly/expensive short-term debt, which had been used to fund a high-spec refurbishment of the property; the property was vacant at the time of enquiry. Result (a) frames the request as 'help with a private bank'; result (b) describes the need as 'a refinance on a standard Buy to Let mortgage, on a full interest only basis'. The deal was sized at 65% loan-to-value on a £7 million valuation. The borrower's income was irregular, so several income sources, including capital disposals, were documented/evidenced through a detailed accountant's letter. Outcome, described by the page as a 'dry lending' solution: £4.55 million GBP loan, 65% LTV, 2.89% variable rate, 5-year term, full interest only, 0.50% bank fee, no AUM (assets under management / wealth management) requirement. Neither result states when the deal completed; search metadata dates the page listing at roughly 230 days before the search (i.e. around March 2026).
